corpus: scripted M7 corpus, test split (prototype pipeline, scripted agents' LLM, SLM offline)

actions.example_what: agent B claimed days_late=8, the data say 0
actions.owner_decision: read the case; the agent stated a fact that contradicts the platform data (the Coordinator re-reads facts, so check the final decision too)
actions.does_not_show: not whether a wrong refund was paid: see the decision in the trace

actions.example_what: the Coordinator sent the proposal back 2 time(s)
actions.owner_decision: the Coordinator had to correct the agent; frequent send-backs mean the agent misreads rules
actions.does_not_show: not a client-facing error (the Coordinator caught it)

actions.example_what: the agents failed; the client was told the case needs an extra check
actions.owner_decision: check the agents' LLM provider and the error handling; the client got the 'extra check' reply

actions.example_what: client asked for a refund the data show is due (R-REF-03), but none was approved
actions.owner_decision: a refund the data show is due (R-REF-03) was not given or offered; read the case
actions.does_not_show: not that the client still wants it

actions.example_what: client wrote in French, the reply is not in French
actions.owner_decision: French-speaking clients were answered in English; add French reply templates (prototype lane)
actions.does_not_show: not that the client could not read English

actions.owner_decision: cases sent to a human; check the human queue capacity

actions.example_what: agent cited rule R-REF-02, which does not exist
actions.owner_decision: agents cite a rule id that is not in the policy file; check the prompts for an old id

actions.example_what: the proposal tool refused the agent's proposal
actions.owner_decision: the proposal tool refused the agent's proposal; check the agent's prompt

actions.example_what: the SLM gave no passing reply; the fixed template was sent
actions.owner_decision: the SLM gave no passing reply, the fixed template was sent; check the SLM service
actions.does_not_show: not that the template reply was bad

actions.example_what: agent answered without using a tool; the pipeline re-ran it
actions.owner_decision: agent first answered without tools; the pipeline re-ran it

actions.example_what: agent cited R-REF-03 without searching the policies
actions.owner_decision: agent cited a rule without looking it up
actions.does_not_show: not that the rule was wrong

internal_consistency.what: agents cited R-REF-02 1 time(s); it is not in the policy file
internal_consistency.owner_action: check the agents' prompts / knowledge for an old rule id
internal_consistency.false_positive_risk: low for code/config refs (exact id match); for agent citations, one LLM slip can repeat in a batch — the support count is shown

coverage.what: no conditional rule covers: delivered, on time
coverage.owner_action: decide what clients in this situation are owed and write it as a rule
coverage.false_positive_risk: high: 'no rule' may be the intended policy (nothing is owed); it is a question, not a defect

coverage.what: no conditional rule covers: delivered, late
coverage.owner_action: decide what clients in this situation are owed and write it as a rule
coverage.false_positive_risk: high: 'no rule' may be the intended policy (nothing is owed); it is a question, not a defect

governance.owner_action: review the wording; add version and last_reviewed
governance.false_positive_risk: none for the fact itself (fields are absent); it says nothing about whether the wording is right

usage.what: condition false in 12/23 checks: agents often apply it where it does not hold
usage.owner_action: check whether the wording still matches how cases look
usage.false_positive_risk: medium/high: depends on the period's case mix (e.g. 'never used' when no client asked); minimum support of 5 conversations applies

usage.what: never cited or retrieved in 120 conversations
usage.owner_action: check whether the rule is still needed
usage.false_positive_risk: medium/high: depends on the period's case mix (e.g. 'never used' when no client asked); minimum support of 5 conversations applies

freshness.why: no dated, authoritative source (law, carrier contract, signed company decision) exists for any rule, and the policy file has no version or date fields; 'outdated' cannot be shown
what_would_make_it_checkable: valid_from / valid_until / last_reviewed / owner fields per rule
a dated source reference per rule (document id + date)
a change log of the policy file
